{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders
completed_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute mean revenue for loyal customers with completed orders
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the number of loyal completed orders
print("Number of loyal completed orders:", len(loyal_completed))

# Print the mean revenue
print("Mean revenue:", mean_revenue)

# Return mean_revenue for submission
mean_revenue"}
